BILL NUMBER:  S4664

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend chapter 613 of the laws of 2007,
relating to creating the New York state sea level rise task force and
providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof,
in relation to extending certain provisions relating thereto

 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL : The purpose of this bill is to
extend the date on which the New York State Sea Level. Rise Task Force
must submit a report, and to also extend the date in which the act
shall expire and be deemed repealed.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS : This bill would extend the provision
which states that the New York State Sea Level Rise Talk Force must
submit a report assessing the anticipated impacts of sea level rise,
as well as providing recommendations related to actions the State may
take to protect areas at risk of damage, adaptive measures, and
regulatory and/or statutory changes. The provision would extend the
due date for the report from December 31, 2009 to December 31, 2010.
The date on which the act shall expire and be deemed repealed will be
extended from January 1, 2010 to January 1, 2011.

 JUSTIFICATION : Unprecedented changes in global climate are underway.
Effects of warming are already evident and these will have extremely
important local impacts that can be and must be anticipated.
Specifically, climate change is resulting in accelerating rates of sea
level rise that - together with unsustainable coastal development and
shore-hardening practices - have the potential to smother important
natural habitats such as beaches, dunes, bluffs and wetlands.

Over 62% of New York's population lives in marine coastal counties.
New York must take action to protect natural habitats from the
unanticipated changes associated with sea level rise. Establishment of
the New York State Sea Level Rise Task Force will help the State
evaluate ways of protecting the State's remaining coastlines and
natural habitats, while applying the best available science as to sea
level rise and its anticipated impacts.

The New York State Sea Level Rise Task Force has requested an
additional year in order to complete their work.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY : New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS : Minimal.

 EFFECTIVE DATE : Immediately.

summary: Extends the provisions of the New York state sea level rise task force.
